'''Ashin''' is a servant for Lord [[Barthanes]] in [[Cairhien]].

==Activities==
Ashin announces the arrival of [[Rand]], [[Verin]], [[Loial]] and [[Ingtar]] to a party at Lord [[Barthanes]]' manor house. {{ref/book|2|32}}
